line: player_3, a roleblocked player only learns that they were blocked, not who did it. So how do you know it was player_4 who came to you? Also, if you're the healer, who did you actually protect on night 2 onward?

player_8's claim fits the record: a vigilante shot player_5 on night 4, which was the only shot that night. If that holds, the Necromancer is player_1 or player_4. I'd vote player_4 for now. They have dodged every claim request since day 3, and I'd like a concrete answer from them before we lynch anyone.

Both wolves are dead, so the only killer left is the serial killer, and my bullets can't touch it at night. It has to go on a day vote. Anyone with a real night result, say what you saw and whose visits, and we can check for overlaps.

Day 2. Player_6's role was hidden, so we have no information from that night. Anyone holding a night result, say it now while the claims are still fresh. Silence on both sides makes this day harder to read.

Nothing to go on yet, and player_6 dying with no role shown doesn't point anywhere. I'm unclaimed. Anyone with a real night result, say the target and what came of it, so we can check claims against each other.

I'm not voting on the role claims alone. I still have one watch, and I'm leaning toward using it on player_7 tonight. A watch shows who came to them, so if they protected someone it would show up. If anyone has a better test for the healer claim, say so before the vote.

I'm not voting anyone yet. player_5's night 3 'visited no one' on player_3 tells us little, since a wolf visit to player_3 could have been hidden anyway. player_6, you want player_7 tested, but you haven't said what role you hold. What are you?

Note for the table: player_9's follow says player_4 visited them on night 2, and player_8's list has player_4 there too. The save and the wolf attack both landed on player_9 that night, so two of player_1, player_4 and player_7 are the healer and the carrier. player_4, did you go to player_9 to protect them?

Player_8's list has a useful implication: the visit from player_10 on night 2 is the Necromancer acting through the investigator's body on player_9, so the Necromancer's night 2 action was not a kill. Player_1 and player_7 still need to say what they did on night 2, since the healer and carrier are two of player_1, player_4 and player_7.

Night 1 I followed player_8 and they visited no one, so that's one thing to check if anyone claims Healer. I'd rather not vote blind on day 2, so I'm waiting to see who gets pushed. Player_2, your check on player_7 is one data point; I'd like a Sentinel or Trailseer claim before we lean on it.

Day 2. Two dead: player_3 and player_9, and player_9's role is hidden, so there's no will to lean on. Nobody has claimed anything yet. I'd rather hear claims than guess. Whoever has a night result, say who you checked or watched and what came back.

Nobody has said anything yet, so I'll start: player_3 was an illusionist and died, so one wolf is already gone. Whoever claims a night result should say who they visited, so we can cross-check. I'm holding my own info for now. Who wants to go first with a claim?

Player_1, if you're really trailseer, tell us who you'll follow tonight and whether a wolf could be hiding behind a fake claim. Nobody should lynch on one unverified claim. I'll hold my check until we have a real target to test.

player_9, you've asked the day-2 voters for reasons three times now, but you haven't said what you'd do with the claim yourself. player_7, you're the one the dead claim cleared. Did anyone check you, or did you get any night result at all?

Since player_2 is gone, the only result left is his Not suspicious on player_7, and nobody can check it now. player_9, you're pressing the day-2 voters hard, but what's your own read on player_2's claim? If you think he was lying, say why. If you think he was honest, the vote on player_2 was the wrong one.

Nobody's claim is checkable yet, so I'm not voting on trails. If I had to vote now it would be player_6: no role claim, and they've said they did nothing on nights 1 and 2. The illusionist is one of 6, 7 or 10, so an unclaimed player is worth a closer look. I'll hear player_7's healer claim and player_5's follow test before deciding anything else.

Player_6, you have made no role claim and have pushed votes on others without saying what you did at night. Who did you visit on nights 2 and 3, and why did you hold fire? If the answer doesn't hold up, I would vote for you today.

Nobody has said anything about the two wolf-side deaths yet. Player_3 and player_10 were both hidden, so their roles are in the Investigator/Sentinel/Trailseer/Vigilante/Sigilist/Healer pool, and the Illusionist is out of conceals. I'd like everyone to say who they'd lynch now, with a reason, so we have something to weigh instead of another abstain.

Nothing from me yet to lynch on. player_5's checks are only a claim, and the one night fact we have is that player_5 was attacked on night 2 and saved. If player_3 or anyone else can confirm a result from their own night, that gives us something to test. I'd abstain for now.

player_6, you claimed sigilist. Did a sigil strike anyone on nights 3 or 4? Four of us are left, so whoever you put a sigil on matters. player_3 and player_7, if you have a role, say it now, before anyone votes on day 5.

Sticking to my account: I checked player_5 on night 2 and it read Suspicious. player_6, you claim sigilist. Who did you place your sigils on, and what did they show? A sigil on someone who attacked would have struck, so a result would tell us something.

Good evening, all. Since the night gave us so little, I would ask each claimant to say which night they acted on and whom, so we can cross-check. player_4 was a chanteuse, which means the pack has one fewer blocker, and player_10's role may be hidden by the illusionist, so no role claim about them can be checked yet. I have no vote to cast today.

player_5, if your follow on player_9 tonight shows no visitors, say that plainly too. Night 2 you were blocked, which means a wolf spent a block on you, so the Trailseer read stays live for now. I have no night information to add, so I'll wait for the follow result before I vote.

Night 2 wolves went after player_5 and the healer saved them, so the pack was targeting the Trailseer. That fits player_5's claim, and it means the wolves know who they're after. I'd like tonight's follow result before anyone votes.

player_10, you say you checked player_5 and got Not suspicious. The Investigator's check is also a visit, so a wolf carrier would look identical at the door. If you're really the Investigator, the check result is what matters: which of player_1 to player_4 do you think is the most likely wolf to test with your last check?

Good evening, friends. player_2, a Not suspicious on player_7 only clears them if you are the genuine Investigator, and a wolf claiming that role could just as easily hand out the same. I would rather hear the Sentinel and Trailseer claims before anyone is cleared.

Two of the info roles are dead now, so whoever is left should be careful about what they reveal. I'd like player_10 to explain the lynch on player_1 more than the thin read they gave. A lynch with no reason is hard to trust, and that's the one thing I can actually test today.

Well, I do think we ought to be careful with the day 2 lynch votes, since neither player_9 nor player_10 gave much to go on. My own view is that the sentinel loss last night means we lost our best watch, so whoever claims a surviving info role should be asked for specifics early rather than in a rush at the vote. player_2, you spoke of checks; do you hold one, and who did you look at?

player_2, the sentinel's night 2 result says you went to player_7. What was that visit for? Player_7 was the investigator, so if you were checking them or protecting them, say so and say what came back.

player_10, you've now told three versions: no visit, then a follow, then a Trailseer claim. Your night 1 follow on player_1 says they visited no one, so what did you see on night 2 that made you change your story? player_1, what did you do on night 1? Your night 2 check is in the open, but I want the first night on record too.

player_10, your Trailseer claim fits player_4's watch: a follow on player_3 would show up there, and 'visited no one' is what you'd see. The thing I'd test is player_1's check, since that's the only other claim that put someone at player_3's door. If player_4 can say whether the watch showed one visitor or three, that narrows it.

player_7, the will shows player_10 went to you on night 1, so a block was on you that night. A blocked player is told they were roleblocked. Did you get that message, or did you just not act? Your answer tells us whether the block took.

Agree we need claims, but let's not rush a lynch on nothing. I'd abstain on any vote today. The healer and the investigator should claim first, since their results can be checked against each other. I'm holding my sigils for now.

Player_10 has now given two different accounts of night 2, so I'd lean toward them for the lynch. If player_10 followed player_3, that is a visit to player_3 that the sentinel saw, and it is the only account that fits. I'd like a clearer answer on whether they went anywhere else that night.

player_1, your night 4 follow on player_5 saw no visits, but the shot on player_8 needed a visitor. Who was that visitor, if not the person you followed? Your claim doesn't fit the morning report, so explain it.

Looking at the record, player_6's sentinel watch on player_9 seeing player_8 lines up with player_8's own follow, which is solid support for player_6. player_5's investigator claim is untested, so a useful test is whether player_5 keeps their Not suspicious reads consistent with who the serial killer might be. I'd like to see player_3 and player_7 state what they did last night so we can narrow the board.
player_7, you claimed sigilist but haven't said where your sigils went. Did you place any on nights 2 to 4, and if so, what happened? Your answer should line up with the deaths we've had.

I'm the vigilante, and I've held fire every night so far. player_7, you named 8 or 9 as the wolf, but I'm town, so you're guessing. If your Investigator claim is real, tell us what you'd do with the Suspicious results; if it's fake, the wolf is near you. I'd vote player_7 today unless someone gives me a better read.

I'm holding my vote for now. If player_7's checks are true, the Chanteuse is player_9, the only one of the four who hasn't given a reason for anything. player_9, what have you based your abstains on? If player_7 is lying, that's a different picture, so I'd like to hear from 2 and 3 first.

player_5 admitted the only elimination vote on record had no information behind it, so I'd rather not lynch anyone on that. If we vote today, my pick would be player_5 for the same reason: an empty push. I'd still like players 7 and 9 to give a reason for abstaining before we go further.

I'd vote for player_5 today. Their day 3 push on player_10 was admitted to be pure read, and they then pushed player_3 with no reason too. I'd rather eliminate someone whose lynch is backed by something, but nothing else on the table is stronger.

Right then, one thing to add: player_4 was the serial killer, and the record says the SK stabbed player_8 on night 1. That fits player_5's claim that player_4 went to player_8, so I'd take player_5's trail seriously. For what it's worth, I visited no one on night 2, which matches player_5's follow of me.

player_3, a follow on player_6 shows where player_6 went, not who came to them, so a wolf visiting me would not show up in player_5's trail at all. That reasoning doesn't back up the claim that player_5 is genuine. Right then, the trail that matters is night 1, where player_4 went to player_8. Anyone who can check that against their own results, say so.

player_7, your night 2 watch lists player_4 as a visitor, but player_4 was a wolf who voted player_1 on day 2. Can you say whether anyone else on that list was a known power role? player_10, you went to player_2 on night 3 by your own account. Did you go as a wolf, or for the check you had in mind? That would tell us whether the night 3 kill was on player_2 by you or by the Illusionist.

player_7, if 8's trail is right, player_10 visited you on night 1. Did you get a roleblock message that night, or nothing at all? That answer tests 8's claim without anyone claiming anything. 5 and 9 line up on the night 2 and 3 saves, so 8's follow of 9 is the piece to check, not a vote on 8 yet.

player_5, you've claimed investigator with two checks. Which night did you check whom, and do you have a result to compare with player_8's trail? Both claims can't be fully tested yet, so asking for specifics is the cheapest test today.

player_7, when exactly did you check player_3, and was it night 3 as you said? Your check count has already changed once, so I want the details straight before I weigh the claim. Until then I lean toward putting you up, because you're the only one making a role claim this day.

If we vote now, I'd put my vote on player_9. The day 2 push on player_4 rested on silence alone, and player_9 has admitted it was thin. I'd still like to hear player_4 answer before we lock anything in.

Player_10 pushed player_1 on day 2 and then said they didn't push anyone, which is a contradiction to note. Player_10 also watched nothing on night 1 that tells us about their role, so their lynch on player_1 is the thing I'd like explained. My vote today would go to player_10 unless they give a reason for the player_1 push.

player_5's night 1 follow is the only hard evidence on the table, and it conflicts with player_4's claim. Whoever is lying, the Trailseer's night 2 result is the quickest test. player_5, post who you followed and what you saw. player_4, if you were at player_9, a Sentinel or Healer could confirm that, so say if you hold either role.

player_9, my night 1 follow on player_4 showed a visit to player_8, and that's all I have confirmed. Nights 2 and 3 I was blocked on player_9, so I got nothing from them. The blocker is a wolf who knows I was going for player_9, so the blocks tell us about the Chanteuse, not about who wanted player_9 safe. player_7, you're pushing player_9 on that logic alone, so explain why it's more than a guess.

player_9, you were asked to explain your night, and you still haven't. I'm not saying the blocks prove anything; I'm saying a player who won't account for their night is hard to trust. My night 1 follow showed player_4 going to player_8, which fits player_4 being the serial killer. I'd vote player_9 today unless you give a real account of your night.

Two blocks on my follow of player_9 means a wolf is actively stopping that follow. player_9 won't say what they did at night, and they're the one everyone's blocks point toward. I'd vote player_9 today unless they give a checkable account of their night.

My sigil killed player_2 on night 3, so I'm town. Wolves are gone, which leaves the Necromancer as player_6 or player_8. Three alive means one more lynch-or-kill and it's over for us, so we can't waste a vote. I'd vote player_6: they've been quiet, and their answer on night 4 didn't say who visited them. player_8, if you watched player_6 on night 4, what did you see, and who came to you?

player_6, you have not said what you did on night 4, and you are the only one of us without a role claim. Player_8's claim can be tested against the record: if they were the sentinel, player_6 should have been visited by player_9, and that is the part you keep deflecting. I'd vote player_6 today unless someone gives a concrete reason not to.

I'm the sigilist, and my sigil on player_2 is the one that struck. I'm keeping my last one for someone who actually attacks. player_8, the night 4 watch depends on player_9 coming to player_6, and player_9 died that night, so I can't check it. player_6, you say the watch can't be checked, but you also haven't said where you went on night 4. If you're the Necromancer, the body you used can't be tested. My vote would be player_6 for now, with low confidence.
